question: By what count and in what kind of womb-diagrams are certain beings said to be tormented?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified here.
That count applies to thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings are stated to be tormented within them.
inference: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are the sites in which those beings are tormented.
uncertainties: Which class of beings is meant remains implicit from this verse alone.
plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
